subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public provider-auth runtime keep attempt as a supported alias while adding apiKeyIndex and attemptNumber, or begin a formal deprecation and removal cycle?
rationale: Because executeWithApiKeyRotation is exported to provider plugins, deprecating attempt establishes external API direction that cannot be inferred safely from the implementation alone.

options.title: Keep the alias supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, add the two explicit fields, and retain attempt as the stable apiKeyIndex alias for compatibility.

options.title: Approve formal deprecation
options.body: Keep the annotation only with an explicit removal release, migration guidance, compatibility window, and focused plugin-SDK upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Keep the alias supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, add the two explicit fields, and retain attempt as the stable apiKeyIndex alias for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the original helper and the public provider-auth SDK boundary where the contract is exported.
